profile.Name: Griffin
profile.Personality: Disciplined and educated, a former soldier of the Holy Nation who lost his faith in Okran and chose reason instead. He carries both guilt and relief about leaving.
profile.Backstory: He served as a Holy Sentinel before he walked away from the Holy Nation, an act it calls apostasy. Former Holy Nation soldiers are not always welcome among the Flotsam Ninjas.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Measured and exact; slips into the rhythm of scripture when stressed and catches himself.
